a: Confession of Elector Frederic III of the Palatinate
What is the honour that inferiors owe to their superiors?
x: …to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said he) a man on the throne of Israel
The honour which inferiors owe to their superiors is, all due reverence in heart, word, and behaviour; prayer and thanksgiving for them;
from which ecclesiastical persons are not exempted
